cross_piece_hypotheses.claim: silence should compete directly with sounded gestures
same harmony can produce different comping actions under different phrase/ensemble context
density is multidimensional rather than note-count only
groove identity should be separable from literal rhythmic realization

technical_cautions: automatic BPM is a beat-tracking estimate and may reflect double-time/half-time ambiguity
Listening and Playalong files are structurally related but not safe to treat as phase-identical mixes
direct waveform subtraction must not be used as a clean piano stem assumption
fine-grained onset/touch labels require later listening/expert confirmation
